name: Ensure mTLS DB Roles
description: Production postgres is cert-only (pg_hba `cert`): every mTLS client-cert CN must map to an existing LOGIN role. addon-mtls is otherwise client-side only; this ensures a passwordless LOGIN role per mtls_cns CN in the postgres dependency container so cert-only apps (e.g. gitea) can authenticate. Idempotent; DB ownership/GRANTs stay app-specific. Skipped for mTLS apps without a postgres dependency via skip_if_all_missing:[database_name] (e.g. eclipse-mosquitto/MQTT) — so it never tries to resolve a postgres dependency there.
